///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

nominal unsigned = ()
nominal signed = ()

union staged s a =
    | Pending :: forall a. string -> staged unsigned a
    | Present :: forall a. a -> staged signed a

union stage s =
    | Unsigned :: stage unsigned
    | Signed :: stage signed

prototype stage_of s : () -> stage s
instance stage_of unsigned = fun () => Unsigned
instance stage_of signed = fun () => Signed

inl staged_read forall s a.
    (witness : stage s) (read : list xml_codec.decode_error -> option a * list xml_codec.decode_error)
    (errors : list xml_codec.decode_error)
    : option (staged s a) * list xml_codec.decode_error
    =
    match witness with
    | Unsigned => Some (Pending "unsigned"), errors
    | Signed =>
        inl value, errors = read errors
        optionm.map (fun v => Present v) value, errors

inl signed_value forall a. (x : staged signed a) : a =
    match x with
    | Present v => v

inl staged_list forall s a b. (f : a -> b) (x : staged s a) : list b =
    match x with
    | Pending _ => []
    | Present v => [ f v ]

type any_content = list xml.xml_node

inl any_content_of (nodes : list xml.xml_node) : any_content = nodes

inl any_content_to (content : any_content) : list xml.xml_node = content

    match x with
    | TTransformURI_enveloped_signature => "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#enveloped-signature"
    | TTransformURI_REC_xml_c14n_20010315 => "http://www.w3.org/TR/2001/REC-xml-c14n-20010315"

instance to_text x_t_transform_uri = fun x => x_t_transform_uri_to_string x

inl x_t_transform_uri_example (k : i32) : x_t_transform_uri =

let rec x_tmd_fe_of_children forall s.
    (witness : stage s) (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_tmd_fe s) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl o_inf_md_fe, errors = xml_codec.read_required "infMDFe" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_of_xml children errors
    inl o_signature, errors =
        staged_read witness
            fun errors => xml_codec.read_required "ds:Signature" x_signature_type_of_xml children errors
            errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_tmd_fe { inf_md_fe = xml_codec.present o_inf_md_fe; signature = xml_codec.present o_signature }

and let x_tmd_fe_of_xml forall s.
    (witness : stage s) (c : xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_tmd_fe s) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    x_tmd_fe_of_children witness (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

and let x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl o_ide, errors = xml_codec.read_required "ide" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_ide_of_xml children errors
    inl o_emit, errors = xml_codec.read_required "emit" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_emit_of_xml children errors
    inl o_inf_modal, errors = xml_codec.read_required "infModal" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_modal_of_xml children errors
    inl o_inf_doc, errors = xml_codec.read_required "infDoc" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_doc_of_xml children errors
    inl o_tot, errors = xml_codec.read_required "tot" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_tot_of_xml children errors
    inl v_lacres, errors = xml_codec.read_repeated "lacres" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_lacres_of_xml children errors
    inl v_aut_xml, errors = xml_codec.read_repeated "autXML" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_aut_xml_of_xml children errors
    inl v_inf_adic, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "infAdic" x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_adic_of_xml children errors
    inl o_versao, errors = xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_t_ver_m_de_of_string "versao" attributes errors
    inl o_id, errors = xml_codec.attribute_parsed x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_id_of_string "Id" attributes errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe {
            ide = xml_codec.present o_ide
            emit = xml_codec.present o_emit
            inf_modal = xml_codec.present o_inf_modal
            inf_doc = xml_codec.present o_inf_doc
            tot = xml_codec.present o_tot
            lacres = v_lacres
            aut_xml = v_aut_xml
            inf_adic = v_inf_adic
            versao = xml_codec.present o_versao
            id = xml_codec.present o_id
        }

and let x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_of_xml (c : xml.xml_node) : result (x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe) (list xml_codec.decode_error) =
    x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_of_children (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_adic) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =

        match f with
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_ide => [ x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_ide_to_xml "ide" v ]
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_emit => [ x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_emit_to_xml "emit" v ]
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_infModal => [ x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_modal_to_xml "infModal" v ]
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_infDoc => [ x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_doc_to_xml "infDoc" v ]
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_tot => [ x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_tot_to_xml "tot" v ]
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_lacres => listm.map (fun v => x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_lacres_to_xml "lacres" v) v
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_autXML => listm.map (fun v => x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_aut_xml_to_xml "autXML" v) v
        | TMDFe_infMDFe_field_infAdic =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_inf_adic_to_xml "infAdic" v) v)
    inl rec walk (fields : list (exists r. x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_field r)) : list xml.xml_node =
        match fields with
        | packed :: rest =>
            inl exists r. f = packed
            listm.append (nodes f (x_tmd_fe_inf_md_fe_get f x)) (walk rest)
        | [] => []
    walk [
        exists TMDFe_infMDFe_field_ide
        exists TMDFe_infMDFe_field_emit
        exists TMDFe_infMDFe_field_infModal
        exists TMDFe_infMDFe_field_infDoc
        exists TMDFe_infMDFe_field_tot

generated_mdfe_v1_00_writes_its_example (test)

test generated_mdfe_v1_00_writes_its_example: passed 
///- --test
///> rust

inl example = x_tmd_fe_example 0i32
inl document =
    xml.element
        "MDFe"
        (("xmlns", "http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/mdfe") :: x_tmd_fe_attributes example)
        (x_tmd_fe_children example)
file_system.directory_create_all (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "") |> ignore
file_system.write_all_text
    (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "generated_mdfe_v1_00_example.xml")
    (xml.write_node (xml.with_namespace "Signature" "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#" document))
inl text = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "generated_mdfe_v1_00_example.xml")
let rec runs (left : i32) (parses : list i64) (writes : list i64) (bytes : i64) : list i64 * list i64 * i64 =
    if left = 0i32
    then parses, writes, bytes
    else
        inl watch = date_time.stopwatch ()
        date_time.stopwatch_start watch
        inl start = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
        match xml.read_xml text with
        | node :: [] =>
            inl parsed = xml_codec.expect_decoded (x_tmd_fe_of_xml Unsigned node)
            inl parsed_at = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
            inl written = xml.write_node (x_tmd_fe_to_xml "MDFe" parsed)
            inl written_at = date_time.stopwatch_elapsed_microseconds watch
            inl parses = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (parsed_at - start) parses
            inl writes = generated_fiscal_runtime.insert_run (written_at - parsed_at) writes
            runs (left - 1i32) parses writes (bytes + sm'.length written)
        | _ => failwith "one MDFe element"
inl _ = runs (dyn 5i32) [] [] 0i64
inl parses, writes, bytes = runs (dyn 31i32) [] [] 0i64
inl row = sm'.(++#) "generated_mdfe_v1_00 parse_us " (generated_fiscal_runtime.median parses)
inl row = sm'.(++#) row (sm'.(++#) " write_us " (generated_fiscal_runtime.median writes))
inl row = sm'.(++#) row (sm'.(++#) " runs 31 bytes " (sm'.obj_to_string bytes))
console.write_line row
match xml.read_xml text with
| node :: [] =>
    inl parsed = xml_codec.expect_decoded (x_tmd_fe_of_xml Unsigned node)
    inl document =
        xml.element
            "MDFe"
            (("xmlns", "http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/mdfe") :: x_tmd_fe_attributes parsed)
            (x_tmd_fe_children parsed)
    inl folder = generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "../target/bench"
    match file_system.directory_create_all folder with
    | Ok _ =>
        file_system.write_all_text
            (sm'.(++#) folder "/ours-generated_mdfe_v1_00_example.xml")
            (xml.write_node (xml.with_namespace "Signature" "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#" document))
    | Error _ => failwith "cannot create target/bench"
| _ => failwith "one MDFe element"
generated_mdfe_v1_00 parse_us 150 write_us 30 runs 31 bytes 28148
0
